parameters.name: AssociateType
parameters.description:
The type of the route table. Valid values:

*   **VSwitch** (default): vSwitch route table
*   **Gateway**: gateway route table

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that it is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

>  If you do not specify this parameter, **ClientToken** is set to the value of **RequestId**. The value of **RequestId** in each API request may be different.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description:
The description of the route table.

The description must be 1 to 256 characters in length, and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) to which the custom route table belongs.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: RouteTableName
parameters.description:
The name of the route table.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length, and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the VPC to which the custom route table belongs.
